title: Tennis Elbow
subtitle: What tennis elbow is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the clinical diagnosis and conservative management of tennis elbow. Moderate evidence supports the use of physical therapy including eccentric exercises. Emerging evidence regarding the role of injections and novel treatments requires further high-quality studies.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
